help:
I answer questions from the {workspace} knowledge base, citing the pages I used.

In a private chat, just ask. In a group, mention me or reply to one of my answers.

Under each answer: 👍 or 👎 to rate it, and 💾 Save to turn the conversation into a page draft or a glossary term (editors).

/new — start a new conversation
/unlink — disconnect your account
/capture — as a reply to the first message of a thread: propose what it settled for the knowledge base (editors). In a private chat, forward me the messages first. Where I am a group admin and keep messages, ✍ on the first message does the same.
/forget — delete the messages of yours I keep for that
/bind — answer in this group (workspace admins)
/unbind — stop answering in this group (workspace admins)
/help — this message
helpTime:
I answer questions from the {workspace} knowledge base, citing the pages I used.

In a private chat, just ask. In a channel, mention me — I answer in the message's thread, and anything else said in that thread is a follow-up.

Under each answer: 👍 or 👎 to rate it, and 💾 Save to turn the conversation into a page draft or a glossary term (editors).

Send one of these words on its own (in a channel, after mentioning me):
new — start a new conversation
unlink — disconnect your account
bind — answer in this channel (workspace admins)
unbind — stop answering in this channel (workspace admins)
capture — propose what this thread settled for the knowledge base, said inside the thread (editors). 📌 on any message of a thread does the same.
help — this message

link.required: Link your account first: open the link below while signed in to {workspace}. It works once and expires in {minutes} minutes.
link.inGroup: You need to link your account before I can answer. Message me privately to do that.
link.success: Linked. Your questions here now run as {user}, with exactly the access you have in {workspace}.
link.unlinked: Disconnected. I will not answer this account until it is linked again.
link.notLinked: This account is not linked to anyone.

answer.failed: I could not answer that — the request to the model failed. Ask again in a moment.
answer.timeout: This answer never arrived: it took too long, or the server restarted. Ask again.
answer.noAccess: Your account no longer has access to {workspace}, so I cannot answer.
answer.disabled: The assistant is switched off for {workspace}.
answer.budget: You have used this month's AI budget in {workspace}.
answer.rateLimited: Too many questions at once — wait a minute and ask again.
answer.empty: Ask me something after the mention.

conversation.new: Started a new conversation. Earlier questions will not be taken into account.

bind.done: I will answer here when mentioned. A workspace admin can change that in Settings → Chat bots.
bind.removed: I will no longer answer in this group.
bind.forbidden: Only a workspace admin with a linked account can do that.

feedback.askReason: What was wrong with it? Pick a reason below.
feedback.linkFirst: Link your account first — message me privately.
feedback.gone: That answer is no longer available to rate.
feedback.failed: Your vote did not go through. Try again.

capture.forbidden: Only an editor of {workspace} with a linked account can save this.
capture.draftingTerm: Looking for the term this conversation defines…
capture.proposed: Proposed for review. Nothing is published until the merge request is merged.
capture.termQueued: Proposed a glossary term. It waits in the Captures inbox until an editor approves it.
capture.duplicate: The knowledge base already has this, so nothing new was proposed.
capture.noPages: This answer cites no page, and only an answer that stands on a page can be saved.
capture.unreadable: This answer cites a page you cannot open, so you cannot save it.
capture.secret: This looks like it contains a credential, so it was not saved.
capture.rateLimited: Too many saves in {workspace} for now. Try again later.
capture.capturesOff: Saving to the knowledge base is switched off in {workspace}.
capture.noTerm: I found no term in this conversation that the glossary does not already have.
capture.nothing: There is nothing in this conversation I can save.
capture.noProject: {workspace} has no project to save into.
capture.disabled: That AI agent is switched off in {workspace}.
capture.failed: Saving did not work. Press Save to try again.

harvest.forbidden: Only an editor of {workspace} with a linked account can ask me to remember a thread.
harvest.off: Harvesting threads into the knowledge base is switched off on this server.
harvest.notInThread: Send capture as a reply inside the thread you want me to remember.
harvest.reading: Reading the thread for what it settled…
harvest.empty: There is nothing in this thread for me to read.
harvest.rateLimited: You have asked me to remember too many threads in the last hour. Try again later.
harvest.unreadable: I could not read this thread. Try again in a moment.
harvest.failed: Reading this thread did not work. Ask again in a moment.
harvest.nothing: Nothing in this thread looked worth keeping.

duplicates.one: {count} was already in the knowledge base and was skipped.
duplicates.other: {count} were already in the knowledge base and were skipped.

truncated.one: I read the first message and the newest {count} reply.
truncated.other: I read the first message and the newest {count} replies.

harvest.replyFirst: Send /capture as a reply to the first message of the thread you want me to remember.
harvest.forwardFirst: Forward me the messages you want me to remember, then send /capture.
harvest.forwardHeld: Got it. Forward the rest of the thread, then send /capture within a couple of minutes.
harvest.listeningOff: I only read the message you replied to: I do not keep this group's messages. A workspace admin can turn that on in the bot's settings.

beforeBuffer.one: The message you replied to is older than what I keep (I keep messages for {count} day, and only since keeping was turned on), so I read it and what I kept after it.
beforeBuffer.other: The message you replied to is older than what I keep (I keep messages for {count} days, and only since keeping was turned on), so I read it and what I kept after it.

reactionNotKept.one: I can't read that message: ✍ works on messages I keep, and I keep this group's messages for {count} day, only while keeping is on. Reply to it with /capture instead.
reactionNotKept.other: I can't read that message: ✍ works on messages I keep, and I keep this group's messages for {count} days, only while keeping is on. Reply to it with /capture instead.

done.one: Deleted {count} message of yours I was keeping.
done.other: Deleted {count} messages of yours I was keeping.

forget.nothing: I am not keeping any messages of yours.

on.one: From now on I keep this group's messages for {count} day, with emails, phone numbers, card numbers and secrets masked, so workspace editors can ask me to /capture a thread for the knowledge base. Nothing kept is searchable. /forget deletes yours.
on.other: From now on I keep this group's messages for {count} days, with emails, phone numbers, card numbers and secrets masked, so workspace editors can ask me to /capture a thread for the knowledge base. Nothing kept is searchable. /forget deletes yours.
